solution:
The correct answer is F-statistics is **7.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **F-statistics i**s a ratio of the between-treatment mean square to the error mean square
 
• It's used in **ANOVA** to test the null hypothesis of equal population means between different groups or treatments.
 
• A larger F-statistic indicates larger difference between the groups, and a smaller value indicates more similarity between the groups.
 
• In ANOVA, the degrees of freedom for the between-treatment mean square is equal to the number of groups minus 1.
 
• The **degrees of freedom** for the error mean square is equal to the total number of observations minus the number of groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• 45/3The **F-statistic** is calculated as the ratio of the between-treatment mean square (MSB) to the error mean square (MSE).
 
• MSB = 45/3 = 15 and MSE = 32/16 = 2, therefore F = MSB/MSE = (15/2)=7.5. 
 
• The F-statistic is used in ANOVA to test the null hypothesis that the population means are equal between different groups or treatments. 
 
• A larger F-statistic value indicates a larger difference between the groups, and a smaller value indicates that the groups are more similar.
